basis.scientific_experiment_scope: Exploratory retrospective direct18 benchmark with simulated label delays; no confirmatory independent attack evaluation.

time_model.unknown_historical_observed_time: null; never substitute block timestamp as observed fact

time_model.event_order_rule: Use validated chain/block/transaction/log or trace order; unresolved ties remain explicit.

evm.status: proposed; freeze after volume pilot and before method comparisons
evm.unit: emitted notification after causal grouping and suppression
evm.hard_limit: causal admission mechanism required; historical quantile alone is insufficient

evm.bounded_study_status: Frozen and executed 18 cells with independent verification; full scientific cross-method grid remains draft.

elliptic.zero_delay_order: predict and record decision before revealing label

calibration.evm_models: fixed domain rules and suitable unsupervised methods; supervised methods only with independent eligible training data
calibration.retraining_calibration: Separate available temporal window excluded from fitting the new model.
calibration.old_model_scores_for_new_model: not automatic; requires separately defined procedure
calibration.insufficient_positives_fallback: Retain the entire active model/threshold pair; scheduling/provenance utility implemented, full-study class minima still to be frozen.
calibration.feedback_assumption: All historically labelled examples become available after the declared delay; selective alert-only feedback is outside the minimum claim.
calibration.elliptic_delay_convention_draft: Prediction and decision for step t precede label release. Label from step s with integer delay d is released after step s+d and may first affect prediction s+d+1. Initial labelled development history and validation availability must be declared separately. Implement an explicit queue; do not reuse M2 known_upto=t-DELAY+1 for a d=0 sweep.

temporal_calibration_implementation.window: latest four available source steps containing known labels; excluded from fitting
temporal_calibration_implementation.activation: strictly increasing successful prediction steps; explicit optional initial activation step
temporal_calibration_implementation.observed_threshold_role: All 150 evaluated batches fill the cap; admitted sets equal unconditional top-k, so this pilot does not identify a threshold-calibration benefit.

pilot.scope: Bounded experiments listed below, including a continuous two-emitter 30-day allocation study; not confirmatory independent attack evaluation.
pilot.purpose: feasibility and implementation correctness, not confirmatory scientific evidence
pilot.implementation_scope: Measured header and protocol-event replay, bounded actual two-model delayed-feedback benchmark, and local process-crash recovery with a specified idempotent SQLite sink; no live end-to-end or independent incident comparison.
pilot.timing_interpretation: Local file read/decode/core/write measured. x1 and compressed arrival schedules use a virtual FIFO clock with measured service costs; no wall-clock pacing, real network or historical observation latency is claimed.
pilot.selection: One date chosen in advance, 2024-03-04 UTC; intensive hour is the maximum sum of transaction_count within that same date, earliest hour breaks ties. Workload-only exploratory selection; not an independent incident.
pilot.historical_finality: Offline canonical archive assumption; no live finality observation and no numerical confirmation delay imposed. Reorg handling unsupported.
pilot.recovery_scope: 12 actual process exits plus three uninterrupted repeats on one Euler day; atomic local state/decision/outbox and separate idempotent SQLite test sink. Conditional unique sink effects, not arbitrary-network exactly-once, kernel-crash or power-loss validation.

event_log_extension.population_day: Euler V1 core all-topic emitter, 2023-03-01 UTC
event_log_extension.completeness: enumerated AWS partition; not independent full-receipt verification

continuous_budget_study.clock: integer historical block-event time as logical simulation time, never observed-time substitution
continuous_budget_study.excluded_run_reason: Five decision gzip artifacts changed/truncated after recorded hashes; cause unestablished. Same-code retry sealed in isolated staging before export.

local_resource_study.initial_role: Semantically valid; known concurrent reference audit; retained in full.
local_resource_study.repeat_role: Identical full technical repetition with other known local agent tasks held; shared host still uncontrolled.
local_resource_study.memory_result: Exact seen and order-key ledgers retain N entries each; checkpoint sizes and whole-process pre-serialization RSS measured at independent-process nested prefixes.
local_resource_study.scope: Local cached instrumented processing and modeled finite FIFO, not live arrival, durable notification or dedicated-host causal speed comparisons.
